ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie, 'perfecting') follows the terminology ledger, and «благо» (blago, 'the good') is 'a good' in the Erasmus passage; the paragraph beginning 'But if only there is a God' stands after the Erasmus attribution and outside the quotation, as printed. Pascal's «плотская смерть» (plotskaya smert') is 'fleshly death', and «начало» (nachalo) in the Cicero passage is 'principle'.
